newsitem.title: USA: Unit rig activity at 11 year high.
newsitem.headline: Unit rig activity at 11 year high.

text.p: Unit Corp said Thursday its contract drilling subsidiary has 19 rigs out of its fleet of 24 rigs operating under contract, representing a 90 percent increase compared to the year end 1995.
Unit Drilling Co has not had 19 rigs active since January 1986, the company pointed out.

The average number of Unit Drilling rigs in use last year was 14.7, compared to 10.9 in 1995, a 35 percent increase, Unit said. The company added day rates currently received are up 15 percent since the beginning of 1996.

"Higher natural gas prices have helped spur demand for drilling rigs," said Earle Lamborn, senior vice president of drilling. "Our current biggest constraint in terms of operating additional rigs is a shortage of rig personnel."
Unit Drilling has provided onshore domestic drilling services in Oklahoma and Texas since 1963.
